chunks: The Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:
Whoever sweeps the mosque on Thursday and the night of Jumu‘ah, and removes from it of the dust that which would be sprinkled into the eye, Allah, the Exalted, will forgive him.

key_terms.التُّرَابِ: dust or earth removed from the mosque
key_terms.الْعَيْنِ: the eye, indicating a very small amount
key_terms.الْمَسْجِدَ: the mosque, the place of worship
key_terms.كَنَسَ: swept or cleaned by brushing away dirt
key_terms.لَيْلَةَ الْجُمُعَةِ: the night of Friday, a blessed time in the Islamic week
key_terms.يُذَرُّ: scattered or sprinkled in tiny particles

ai.seo_question: What is the reward for sweeping and cleaning the mosque on Thursday night?
ai.summary: This hadith encourages caring for the mosque even through a small act such as removing a tiny amount of dust. It shows the great reward Allah grants for honoring sacred spaces and serving the community of worshippers.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.700 - The Messenger of Allah (sw) said:
"Whoever sweeps the mosque on Thursday and the night of Jumu’ah (Thursday night) and removes from it even the dust that could irritate the eye, Allah (swt), the Exalted, will forgive them."
